fontLicensePolicy: Existing renamed Source Sans 3 Regular WOFF2 reused unchanged at weight400 in both variants. Original source and OFL notice retained.
mode: Reused generated photographs and presentation stages. Native SVG composition and one fixed grayscale filter. No new image generation.

layout_record.method: Color originals and revisions plus matched grayscale checks. One fixed linearRGB matrix maps each linear-light channel to0.2126R+0.7152G+0.0722B without changing alpha. The same filter covers each complete artifact; it is not a color-vision simulation or print proof.

comparisonPolicy: Four workshop detail fills darken; six A/B identifiers become visible; one Change date underline becomes visible. Existing words, color palette in the latter two, font settings, geometry, sources/crops and presentation remain fixed. Both color originals/revisions are duplicated through the exact same grayscale filter.

verification.pixelCheck: Only declared repair regions differ in both color and grayscale. Grayscale surfaces contain neutral pixels. Original/revision use the exact same filter and artifact nodes.
verification.textBounds: within the paper or phone surface
verification.scope: Exact DOM normalization permits only four fills, six identifier opacities or one underline opacity. Color/grayscale artifacts share identical children; only the same preview filter differs. Pixel checks isolate repair regions in both views and confirm neutral grayscale pixels. Wide/narrow checks cover loaded fonts, bounds, overflow and image/inline equality.

limitations: A documented diagnostic conversion, not a simulation of every color-vision difference or a prediction of a printer. Grayscale appearance is not a contrast measurement or accessibility certification. Category labels and underline repairs are editorial examples of additional visible cues. No reader-performance study, physical print proof or implemented interface is claimed.
